C0791.title: Alert: Leaking Chipmakers' Core Supply Chain Data Abroad Constitutes a Crime Even for Minimal Profit
C0791.summary: In 2025, Tian, a senior procurement manager at a Shanghai-based semiconductor manufacturing company, was commissioned by an overseas consulting firm and disclosed the company's 2022 silicon wafer supplier list, procurement ratios, and other core supply chain data during a conference call, illegally earning RMB 3,685.92.
